## Overview

This document runs three sensitivity exercises for a Matrix Completion Panel (MCP) estimator:

- **Loop A:** Shrink the donor pool ($N$) while keeping $T$ fixed. Examines how in-sample RMSE changes as the number of available control units decreases.
- **Loop B:** Shrink $T$ while keeping $N$ fixed. Examines how MCP performs with a shorter time dimension. The panel is truncated from the right, so later years are removed first. Iterations with no treated cells are skipped.
- **Loop C:** Per-cohort pre-treatment window sensitivity. For each treatment cohort $C$, restricts usable pre-treatment information to $k_\text{pre}$ periods and refits MCP. The resulting cohort-specific ATT is compared across different values of $k_\text{pre}$.

**Input:** `data/df_covs_linear.csv`  
**Outputs:** `output/sim_shrink_N.csv`, `output/sim_shrink_T.csv`, `output/sim_cohort_prewindow.csv`

## Setup

### Packages

```{r packages}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(MCPanel)
})
```

### Parameters

```{r parameters}
NUM_RUNS      <- 10L
SEED_MCP      <- 1234L
TOL_L         <- 1e-8
N_GRID_LENGTH <- 15L  # Number of grid points for Loop A
```

> `N_GRID_LENGTH` controls how many distinct $N$ values are tested in Loop A. Testing every possible $N$ would be computationally expensive, so a grid is used instead.

```{r load-data}
mpdta <- read_csv(
  "data/df_covs_linear.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

## Build Panel Matrices

Units are ordered by treatment timing (later-treated units first; never-treated/control units at the bottom). The treatment indicator `t` equals 1 only for post-treatment periods of treated units.

```{r build-panel-matrices}
build_panel_matrices <- function(df) {

  df <- df |>
    mutate(
      t_group = as.integer(year >= firsttreat),
      t       = treat * t_group
    )

  # Units ordered by treatment timing; controls (firsttreat = 0) go last
  unit_order <- df |>
    distinct(countyreal, firsttreat) |>
    arrange(desc(firsttreat), countyreal) |>
    pull(countyreal)

  to_wide <- function(var) {
    df |>
      select(countyreal, year, all_of(var)) |>
      pivot_wider(
        names_from  = year,
        values_from = all_of(var),
        values_fn   = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      ) |>
      arrange(match(countyreal, unit_order)) |>
      select(-countyreal) |>
      mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) |>
      as.matrix()
  }

  Y         <- to_wide("lemp")
  treat_mat <- to_wide("t")
  years     <- as.integer(colnames(Y))

  first_treat <- df |>
    distinct(countyreal, firsttreat) |>
    arrange(match(countyreal, unit_order)) |>
    pull(firsttreat)

  list(
    Y           = Y,
    treat_mat   = treat_mat,
    years       = years,
    first_treat = first_treat,
    unit_order  = unit_order
  )
}

mats <- build_panel_matrices(mpdta)

full <- list(
  Y           = mats$Y,
  treat_mat   = mats$treat_mat,
  years       = mats$years,
  first_treat = mats$first_treat,
  X           = NULL,
  Z           = NULL
)

Nn <- nrow(full$Y)
Tt <- ncol(full$Y)
```

```{r panel-summary, echo=FALSE}
cohort_labels <- paste(
  sort(unique(full$first_treat[full$first_treat > 0])),
  collapse = ", "
)
message(sprintf(
  "[data] N = %d units, T = %d periods, cohorts: %s",
  Nn, Tt, cohort_labels
))
```

The panel contains **`r Nn` units** across **`r Tt` time periods**, with treatment cohorts in years: `r cohort_labels`.

## Helper Functions

### MCP Fitting Wrapper

The mask convention is:

| Value | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| `mask = 1` | Observed / untreated cell (used by MCP) |
| `mask = 0` | Treated / masked cell (imputed by MCP) |

RMSE is computed over observed (untreated) cells only.

```{r fit-mcp}
fit_mcp <- function(sl, num_runs = NUM_RUNS, seed = SEED_MCP) {

  Y         <- sl$Y
  treat_mat <- sl$treat_mat
  mask      <- 1 - treat_mat   # 1 = observed, 0 = masked

  N <- nrow(Y)
  T <- ncol(Y)

  rmse_v <- numeric(num_runs)
  fit    <- NULL

  set.seed(seed)

  for (i in seq_len(num_runs)) {

    # Treated cells set to zero; mask tells mcnnm_cv() which cells are observed
    Y_obs <- Y * mask

    fit <- mcnnm_cv(
      Y_obs,
      mask,
      to_estimate_u = 1L,
      to_estimate_v = 1L
    )

    # Reconstruct untreated potential outcomes
    fit$Mhat <-
      fit$L +
      replicate(T, fit$u) +
      t(replicate(N, fit$v))

    # Reconstruction errors on observed cells only
    fit$msk_err <- (fit$Mhat - Y) * mask

    n_observed <- sum(mask)

    rmse_v[i] <- if (n_observed > 0) {
      sqrt(sum(fit$msk_err^2) / n_observed)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  }

  list(
    fit       = fit,
    rmse_mean = mean(rmse_v, na.rm = TRUE),
    rmse_se   = sd(rmse_v, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(num_runs)
  )
}
```

### Panel Slicing

Retains the first `n` units and first `t` time periods. Loop A varies `n` (with `t = Tt`); Loop B varies `t` (with `n = Nn`).

```{r slice-panel}
slice_panel <- function(full, n, t) {

  stopifnot(n <= nrow(full$Y), t <= ncol(full$Y))

  list(
    Y         = full$Y[1:n, 1:t, drop = FALSE],
    treat_mat = full$treat_mat[1:n, 1:t, drop = FALSE],
    X = if (!is.null(full$X)) full$X[1:n, , drop = FALSE] else NULL,
    Z = if (!is.null(full$Z)) full$Z[1:t, , drop = FALSE] else NULL
  )
}
```

### Helper to extract ATT

```{r summarize-fit}
# Shared table-row builder for all three loops.
# att_mask defines which Y-cells count toward ATT (1 = counts); it is NOT
# necessarily the same mask used to fit MCP (Loop C differs on this point).
summarize_fit <- function(res, Y, att_mask, n, t, extra = list()) {
  out <- data.frame(n = n, t = t, rmse = NA_real_, att = NA_real_,
                     status = "ok", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (length(extra) > 0) out <- cbind(out, as.data.frame(extra, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))

  if (inherits(res, "try-error")) {
    out$status <- "mcp_error"
    return(out)
  }

  n_att <- sum(att_mask)
  if (n_att == 0L) {
    out$status <- "no_treated_cells"
    return(out)
  }

  effect   <- (res$fit$Mhat - Y) * att_mask
  out$rmse <- res$rmse_mean
  out$att  <- sum(-effect) / n_att   # global ATT over the att_mask cells
  out
}
```


### Single-Iteration Runner (Loops A and B)

```{r run-one}
# Loops A and B: the fitting mask IS the ATT mask (no separate cohort window).
run_one <- function(sl, n, t) {
  n_masked <- sum(sl$treat_mat)
  if (n_masked == 0L) {
    return(data.frame(n = n, t = t, rmse = NA_real_, att = NA_real_,
                       status = "no_treated_cells"))
  }
  res <- try(fit_mcp(sl), silent = TRUE)
  summarize_fit(res, sl$Y, att_mask = sl$treat_mat, n = n, t = t)
}
```

## Loop A: Shrink $N$

All treated units are always retained. The number of control units is reduced according to the grid. RMSE is expected to rise as the donor pool shrinks.

```{r loop-a}
treated_rows <- which(full$first_treat > 0)
control_rows <- which(full$first_treat == 0)

N_treated  <- length(treated_rows)
N_controls <- length(control_rows)

message(sprintf(
  "[loop A] treated units = %d, control units = %d",
  N_treated, N_controls
))

# Grid of total N values; minimum is N_treated (no controls removed beyond that)
N_grid <- unique(round(seq(
  from       = Nn,
  to         = N_treated,
  length.out = N_GRID_LENGTH
)))

message(sprintf(
  "[loop A] N grid (%d points): %s",
  length(N_grid),
  paste(N_grid, collapse = ", ")
))

res_N <- bind_rows(lapply(N_grid, function(n) {

  n_controls_keep <- n - N_treated
  rows_keep       <- c(treated_rows, control_rows[seq_len(n_controls_keep)])

  message(sprintf(
    "  N = %d (%d treated + %d controls) ...",
    n, N_treated, n_controls_keep
  ))

  sl <- list(
    Y         = full$Y[rows_keep, , drop = FALSE],
    treat_mat = full$treat_mat[rows_keep, , drop = FALSE],
    X = if (!is.null(full$X)) full$X[rows_keep, , drop = FALSE] else NULL,
    Z = full$Z
  )

  run_one(sl, n, Tt)
}))
```

```{r loop-a-summary}
res_N
```

---

## Loop B: Shrink $T$

The panel is truncated from the right (later years removed first). Iterations where the truncated panel contains no treated cells are skipped automatically.

```{r loop-b}
message("[loop B] shrinking T from Tt down to 2 ...")

res_T <- bind_rows(lapply(Tt:2, function(t) {
  message(sprintf("  T = %d ...", t))
  sl <- slice_panel(full, n = Nn, t = t)
  run_one(sl, Nn, t)
}))
```

```{r loop-b-summary}
res_T
```

## Loop C: Per-Cohort Pre-Treatment Window Sensitivity

For each treatment cohort $C$ and each $k_\text{pre} \in \{1, \dots, \text{max\_pre}\}$:

1. Restrict MCP to only the last $k_\text{pre}$ pre-treatment periods for that cohort (earlier periods are masked).
2. Refit MCP on the modified panel.
3. Compute the cohort ATT using the **original** treated cells (not the modified mask).

```{r per-cohort-one}
per_cohort_one <- function(cohort, k_pre) {

  Y         <- full$Y
  treat_mat <- full$treat_mat   # will be modified for fitting only
  years     <- full$years
  ft        <- full$first_treat

  cohort_rows <- which(ft == cohort)
  cutoff_year <- cohort - k_pre
  drop_cols   <- which(years < cutoff_year)

  if (length(drop_cols) > 0) {
    treat_mat[cohort_rows, drop_cols] <- 1L   # exclude these from fitting
  }

  sl  <- list(Y = Y, treat_mat = treat_mat)
  res <- try(fit_mcp(sl), silent = TRUE)

  # ATT uses the ORIGINAL treated cells for this cohort, not the modified mask
  post_cols <- which(years >= cohort)
  att_mask  <- matrix(0, nrow(Y), ncol(Y))
  att_mask[cohort_rows, post_cols] <- 1

  summarize_fit(res, Y, att_mask = att_mask,
                n = length(cohort_rows), t = length(post_cols),
                extra = list(cohort = cohort, k_pre = k_pre))
}
```


```{r loop-c}
cohorts <- sort(unique(full$first_treat[full$first_treat > 0]))

message("[loop C] per-cohort pre-window sensitivity ...")

res_cohort <- bind_rows(lapply(cohorts, function(cohort) {

  max_pre <- sum(full$years < cohort)
  if (max_pre < 1L) return(NULL)

  bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(max_pre), function(k_pre) {
    message(sprintf("  cohort %d, k_pre = %d ...", cohort, k_pre))
    per_cohort_one(cohort, k_pre)
  }))
}))
```

```{r loop-c-summary}
res_cohort
```
